transformation_rule: Copied unchanged as the node identifier of the article.
missing_value_behavior: Not applicable: present in all 1,000 records.
validation_rule: Unique; matches https://doaj.org/article/ followed by 32 hex characters.
semantic_limitations: Identifies the DOAJ article record, not the work itself. Chosen because it is the only identifier present for every record; the DOI is missing for 23.

transformation_rule: Constant value dcterms:BibliographicResource for each article node.
semantic_limitations: Assigned by the mapping because DOAJ indexes journal articles; not a value from the source.

transformation_rule: OpenRefine: trim; null if blank. Script: plain string literal.
semantic_limitations: No language tag, because the language of the title is not recorded and can differ from dcterms:language.

transformation_rule: OpenRefine: split on |, trim each name, store as JSON array. Script: one dcterms:Agent node with foaf:name per name, in source order.
missing_value_behavior: Property omitted when the array is empty.
validation_rule: Names equal the |-split Authors values in the same order and spelling.
semantic_limitations: Names are literals; no authority identifiers (ORCID, GND, VIAF). Order is kept in the JSON array but is not part of the RDF graph. Name forms are mixed (direct and inverted).

transformation_rule: Pipe-delimited copy kept in the CSV for audit; superseded by creators_json.
semantic_limitations: A single delimited string would describe one creator, not several.

transformation_rule: OpenRefine: https://doi.org/ + trimmed DOI; null if blank. Script: string literal.
missing_value_behavior: Property omitted; no DOI is generated.
validation_rule: Equals https://doi.org/ + DOI; DOI matches ^10.[0-9]{4,9}/ followed by non-space characters.
semantic_limitations: String literal, as dcterms:identifier has range rdfs:Literal. DOI registration was not checked online.

transformation_rule: OpenRefine: trim. Script: untyped string literal.
validation_rule: Matches NN/NN/NNNN and is not typed as xsd:date.
semantic_limitations: Not ISO 8601. Day-first vs month-first is not confirmed by an independent source. The lifecycle event the date refers to is not stated.

transformation_rule: OpenRefine: trim of the code normalized in Project 01. Script: string literal.
validation_rule: One of en, es, fr; equals Language_normalized; consistent with raw Language.
semantic_limitations: Literal BCP 47 tag (allowed by the DCMI usage note), not a LinguisticSystem URI. Language as reported by DOAJ, not verified against the full text.

transformation_rule: Raw value kept in the CSV for audit.
Kept in the CSV for audit; source of dcterms:language.
OpenRefine: split on |, trim each value, store as JSON array. Script: list of string literals in source order.
missing_value_behavior: Property omitted when the array is empty.
validation_rule: Values equal the |-split Subjects values, including order and duplicates.
semantic_limitations: Mix of free keywords and values that look like Library of Congress Classification labels and notations; no vocabulary is declared, so none is claimed. Duplicate values collapse into one RDF triple.

transformation_rule: OpenRefine: split on |, trim, JSON array. Script: one journal node (dcterms:BibliographicResource) linked with dcterms:isPartOf, carrying all ISSNs as dcterms:identifier.
missing_value_behavior: dcterms:isPartOf omitted when there is no ISSN.
validation_rule: ISSNs equal the |-split ISSNs values; format NNNN-NNNC.
semantic_limitations: ISSNs identify the journal, never the article. Print and electronic ISSN are not distinguished. The identifier scheme is implicit. Journal title not extracted. Assumes all ISSNs in one record belong to the same journal.

transformation_rule: OpenRefine: trim; null if blank. Script: one dcterms:Agent node with foaf:name.
semantic_limitations: Name literal only; no authority link. DOAJ records the publisher of the journal.

transformation_rule: Copied unchanged (not part of the OpenRefine operations).
semantic_limitations: Partial, unstructured citation (journal, volume, issue, pages, year) without authors or title.

validation_rule: One of CC BY, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-ND.
semantic_limitations: Literal label without version or URI, so it cannot be resolved to a specific Creative Commons legal code. Describes the article, not the metadata.
